help:
usage: gnd exp [-h] {init,validate,author-expectation,run,close} ...

Work with experiments — the unit that carries a question, the run that
answered it, and the evidence for the answer. This lane owns the structural
INVARIANTS (does the spec parse, does every declared question id resolve, does
every evidence pointer name a file inside the experiment); the language — what
makes a good question or a good conclusion — belongs to the skill. Fully
offline: an experiment's recorded conclusion is only worth something if a
reviewer can recompute it from the committed tree.

positional arguments:
  {init,validate,author-expectation,run,close}
    init                scaffold a new experiment directory with its SPEC.md
    validate            check that an experiment directory is structurally
                        well-formed
    author-expectation  hash an exact answer, remove its source, and reject
                        any surviving copy
    run                 run one bounded attempt for a data-driven experiment
    close               has this experiment discharged every question it
                        declared?

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
